title: Author WAL Schema, Read-Only and Idempotent Injection Tests
instructions: Create the file: this chunk owns the module docstring, imports and constants. Write physical pytest cases (real SQLite WAL files, real threads; no mock objects): test_ch04_jobs_* for DATA_MODEL:jobs (section 7 CREATE TABLE); test_ch04_fr_001_* for SRS-412-04-FR-001 (The task blackboard shall operate over SQLite in Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) mode with `PRAGMA synchronous = NORMAL` and `PRAGMA busy_timeout = 30000`.); test_ch04_fr_007_* for SRS-412-04-FR-007 (Observers, telemetry monitors, and SRE watchdogs shall connect using read-only database URIs (`file:job_board.db?mode=ro`).); test_ch04_fr_008_* for SRS-412-04-FR-008 (Task batch injection shall be completely idempotent via unique `task_id` constraints and `INSERT OR IGNORE`.); test_ch04_nfr_tm_02_* for NFR-TM-02 (The SQLite database WAL checkpointing shall not block read queries.); test_ch04_database_lock_contention_* for FAILURE:Database Lock Contention (`PRAGMA busy_timeout = 30000` retries automatically for up to 30 seconds before failing cleanly.). Section 9 obligations: Test asserts observer connection opens with `?mode=ro`.
